name: temporal
description: A one-dimensional temporal region (obo:BFO_0000038) is reified as an individual whose extent is given by obo:BFO_0000222 (has first instant) and obo:BFO_0000224 (has last instant) pointing at zero-dimensional regions. Other entities attach to it through obo:BFO_0000199.
